title: Model intake to 90-day success radar and ops orchestra
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Purpose: create a repeatable intake -> launch -> first-90-days measurement playbook for new model additions that bundles catalog readiness, benchmark baselines, docs artifacts, release notes, and cross-team ops signals. Scope: one new model onboarding flow to be piloted with the next catalog addition. Out of scope: major UI redesigns, infra provisioning requests beyond defined Dedicated capacity templates.
tasks: Finalize benchsuite and canonical prompt set for model family (owner: Applied ML)
Produce performance summary tile copy and cost/latency breakdowns for catalog card (owner: PM)
Draft release notes and structured changelog entries (owner: Docs)
Create rollout policy: canary percentage, fallback variant mapping, and monitoring hooks (owner: Runtime)
Prepare SDK example snippets and Quickstart sample app PR (owner: DevX)
Schedule cross-functional launch dry run two weeks prior to publish (owner: PM)
Define 90-day success radar metrics and dashboards (owner: Product Analytics)
acceptance_criteria: Catalog entry published with verified model artifact and metadata (model id, family, quantization profiles)
Benchmarks recorded in the canonical benchsuite and linked in the catalog card
Docs and SDK examples merged and included in the release notes draft
Rollout policy deployed with automated fallback and alerting configured
Post-launch dashboard with first-90-day metrics created and seeded with baseline data
communication_plan: T-14d: Cross-functional dry run invite to stakeholders with playbook PDF
T-7d: Final release notes preview in #catalog-announcements for review
T-1d: Publish readiness check in #launch-ops with go/no-go vote
Launch day: Post short announcement and link to catalog card + benchmarks
Day 7/30/90: Automated status e-mails to stakeholders with metric snapshots
launch_timeline: 2026-03-02: Benchsuite experiment seeds and smoke tests
2026-03-05: Docs PR draft and SDK snippet ready for review
2026-03-10: Dry run with runtime canary simulation
2026-03-17: Publish catalog card and release notes (planned)
2026-03-24: One-week health review and first fixes
risk_and_mitigations: Risk: Benchmarks vary under production traffic. Mitigation: run benchsuite under production-like batching profiles and include both median and p95 latencies.
Risk: SDK example breaks due to API change. Mitigation: include pinned SDK version in examples and add CI smoke test on the sample app.
Risk: Model degrades on specific prompt families. Mitigation: add regression alerts tied to canonical prompt set and schedule immediate rollback window in rollout policy.
Risk: Release notes miss a compliance item. Mitigation: checklist includes security/compliance sign-off step with 48-hour SLA.
post_launch_metrics: Adoption: number of unique API keys calling model per day (target: 200 by day 30)
Cost per 1k tokens vs baseline model (target: <= 1.15x baseline)
Latency p50/p95 under typical batching (target: p95 <= 450ms)
Quality: regression rate on canonical prompt suite (target: < 1% false negatives)
Reliability: error rate and fallback rate (target: error rate < 0.1%)
rollout_policy: Phase 1 (canary): 5% external traffic with automatic health checks
Phase 2 (ramped): 20% -> 50% over 48h windows based on health signals
Phase 3 (full): 100% if no critical regressions after 7 days
Fallback: automatic switch to previous variant if regression or SLO breach detected
